title: (Pwn2Own) Docker Desktop extension-manager Exposed Dangerous Function Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Docker Desktop. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute high-privileged code within the container in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the the implemention of the Docker Extensions functionality. The issue results from an exposed dangerous function. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the host.
